adds.title: The Punisher S1#10
adds.text: Mahoney's officers corner Frank at the hotel after the bombing, but Frank walks out behind Karen as cover and gets away while Mahoney orders his men to hold fire.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The vigilante who slips past Mahoney's officers at the hotel.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The detective whose officers corner Frank at the hotel.
adds.evidence: TP110 'Virtue of the Vicious': Mahoney's unit blocks the kitchen exit; Karen steps out with Frank behind her; Mahoney orders 'Hold your fire', demands 'Let her go, Castle', and Frank escapes via the elevator.

adds.title: The Punisher S1#10
adds.text: Mahoney questions Karen after the hotel attack, and she insists Frank saved her life and is not a terrorist. He accepts her account is likely true.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A witness who tells Mahoney Frank is not a terrorist.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The detective who questions Karen after the hotel attack.
adds.evidence: TP110: Mahoney interviews Page as a witness; she says Castle was looking out for her and is not a terrorist; he notes she could be arrested for helping Castle but acknowledges she is likely telling the truth. Wikipedia #10: Mahoney interrogates survivors including Page.

adds.title: The Punisher S1#3
adds.text: A flashback to Kandahar shows Schoonover overruling Frank's warning that their mission is a trap, then Frank taking command and saving the unit after Schoonover is badly wounded in the ambush.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Frank's old commander, who overrules his warning in Kandahar.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The soldier who takes command and saves the unit in Kandahar.
adds.evidence: TP103 'Kandahar' flashbacks: Major Schoonover introduces Castle and Russo as team leaders, ignores Castle's warning the mission is a trap; in the ambush Schoonover loses an arm and Castle takes over command and checks on him. Wikipedia #3: Castle saved Russo, Major Ray Schoonover and other Cerberus members.

adds.title: The Punisher S1#13
adds.text: A flashback shows Frank's last picnic in Central Park with Maria, Lisa and Frank Jr. by the carousel, shortly before the shootout that kills them.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Wife and children, seen at their last picnic in Central Park.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Husband and father, at the family's last picnic in Central Park.
adds.evidence: TP113 'Memento Mori' flashback (not a dream): Frank takes Maria and the children to Central Park with Billy Russo for a picnic while Lisa rides the carousel. Fandom lists TP113 as flashbacks, TP111/TP112 as dreams.

adds.title: The Punisher S1#9
adds.text: When the bomber sends Karen a letter, Ellison insists they call the FBI before printing it with her reply, then confronts her with the news that Frank Castle is alive.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Karen's editor, who handles the bomber's letter with her.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The reporter whose letter from the bomber Ellison takes to the FBI.
adds.evidence: TP109 'Front Toward Enemy': Ellison is called to Page's office over the bomber's letter, recommends calling the FBI, agrees to an editorial only with FBI permission, then storms in asking if she knew Castle was alive. Wikipedia #9: Page publishes the letter in the Bulletin with a rebuttal.

adds.title: Daredevil S3#11
adds.text: When Foggy surrenders Karen at Clinton Church, Mahoney claims her from the FBI, lets them both go, and tells Foggy every cop in the city will back them against Fisk.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An old friend Mahoney promises the NYPD's backing against Fisk.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An old friend who gets Foggy and Karen away from the FBI.
adds.evidence: DD311 'Reunion': Foggy surrenders Page to the NYPD; Mahoney arrests her under state law against Poindexter's objection, drives Page and Nelson away, frees her and says 'If you can find a way to bring down that son of a bitch, every cop in the city is gonna have your back.'

adds.title: Daredevil S3#11
adds.text: Mahoney takes Karen into police custody at Clinton Church to keep her from the FBI agents working for Fisk, then takes off her handcuffs and lets her go.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Mahoney keeps out of the FBI's hands.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who keeps Karen out of the FBI's hands.
adds.evidence: DD311: Mahoney arrests Page at the church, refuses to hand her to Poindexter, agrees with Nadeem to keep her from the FBI, then frees her from her handcuffs outside.

adds.title: Daredevil S3#12
adds.text: Mahoney hides Ray Nadeem's family at his mother's home for Matt and Foggy, and pulls over the district attorney's car so they can arrange Nadeem's testimony.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend whose plan for Nadeem Mahoney helps.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An NYPD friend who helps protect Nadeem's family.
adds.evidence: DD312 'One Last Shot': Mahoney is called upon by Nelson, Page and Murdock to protect Nadeem's family at Bess Mahoney's home, and is recruited by Nelson and Murdock to pull over Blake Tower about Nadeem's testimony.

adds.title: Daredevil S3#4
adds.text: Marci, now living with Foggy, talks him into running for district attorney against Blake Tower to put Fisk back in prison.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Girlfriend who talks Foggy into running for DA.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Boyfriend whom Marci talks into running for DA.
adds.evidence: DD304 'Blindsided': Stahl advises Nelson to stand up to Fisk and suggests he run for District Attorney against Tower. Wikipedia #4: Foggy 'is convinced by his girlfriend Marci Stahl to run for district attorney against Tower'.

adds.title: Daredevil S3#9
adds.text: Fisk's fixer threatens Foggy's family unless Foggy publicly apologizes for speaking out against Fisk at the debate.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The crime lord whose fixer threatens Foggy's family.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A DA candidate whose family Fisk has threatened.
adds.evidence: Wikipedia Daredevil S3 #9 'Revelations': 'Manning threatens Foggy's family unless he publicly apologizes for speaking out against Fisk at the debate.' #11: Foggy considers reading a statement apologizing to Fisk.

adds.title: Daredevil S3#9
adds.text: A flashback shows Jack falling for Maggie, a young nun who tends his wounds, and being left to raise their baby son Matt alone when she returns to her order.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Jack's son, left with him as a baby.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Father, who raises Matt alone after Maggie leaves.
adds.evidence: DD309 flashbacks: boxer Jack meets young nun Maggie Grace, who treats his wounds; they have a son, Matthew; Maggie returns to life as a nun, leaving Jack alone with their son. (The gym scene with Jack in DD309 is a hallucination and is not used.)

adds.title: The Punisher S2#11
adds.text: Mahoney stops Karen in the hospital during Frank's escape and, seeing she has no shoes, guesses she has helped him get away.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Mahoney catches helping Frank escape.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The detective who catches Karen helping Frank escape.
adds.evidence: TP211 'The Abyss': Mahoney encounters Page without shoes in the hospital; she says she gave them to a worthy cause, which he knows means she assisted Castle's escape.

adds.title: The Punisher S2#8
adds.text: Curtis backs Frank in the shootout with Russo's gang, takes out their sniper, and fires a warning shot at Mahoney to free Frank when the detective corners him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Curtis's closest friend, whom he frees from Mahoney.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Frank's closest friend, who frees him from Mahoney.
adds.evidence: Wikipedia Punisher S2 #8 'My Brother's Keeper': Hoyle takes out the sniper; Castle and Hoyle cannot kill Russo; Mahoney corners Castle but Hoyle and Castle get the better of him. Fandom (TP208): a shot fired inches from Mahoney's head by Hoyle.

adds.title: The Punisher S2#3
adds.text: After turning down Frank's call for help, Madani flies in by helicopter as Pilgrim's men hit the Larkville station and takes Frank to New York to help deal with Russo.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A man Madani rescues from Larkville to help with Russo.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who rescues Frank from Larkville by helicopter.
adds.evidence: Wikipedia Punisher S2 #2: Castle calls Madani for help but she turns him down. #3 'Trouble the Water': Madani arrives in a helicopter and takes Castle to help deal with Russo.

adds.title: The Punisher S2#2
adds.text: Hernandez reprimands Madani over dinner for visiting Billy Russo in the hospital and orders her to stay away from him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Madani's mentor, who orders her away from Russo.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Hernandez's protege, who keeps visiting Russo.
adds.evidence: Wikipedia Punisher S2 #2 'Fight or Flight': Madani is reprimanded by Rafael Hernandez, her mentor, for continuing to visit Russo. Fandom TP202: dinner scene, he tells her to stay away from Russo.

adds.title: The Punisher S2#11
adds.text: Karen visits Frank in the hospital after his arrest, helps prove Russo killed the three women, and sets off the fire alarms so he can slip out.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A close friend who helps Frank escape the hospital.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A close friend Karen helps escape the hospital.
adds.evidence: Wikipedia Punisher S2 #11 'The Abyss': Mahoney arrests Castle; Page visits him in hospital; Page and Madani learn the women were executed by Russo; Page sets off the fire alarms as cover.

adds.title: The Punisher S2#5
adds.text: Frank forces Turk to set up a meeting with the Russian gangster Konchevsky, and the Russians make Turk set an ambush for Frank instead.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A crook Frank forces to set up a meeting.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Forces Turk to set up a meeting with the Russians.
adds.evidence: Wikipedia Punisher S2 #5 'One-Eyed Jacks': Castle coerces former arms dealer Turk Barrett into setting up a meeting with Konchevsky; the Russians force Barrett to set up an ambush for Castle at Barrett's apartment.
